subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling on the wall near the entrance trees and can be defeated with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Take aim to your right where there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [047] crawling around on the wall and defeat it using the Hookshot, then grab the token.

subject: Small Key
text: A small chest on a tree branch near the entrance contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Walk out onto the branch and jump to the other tree branch, there you will find a small chest with a SMALL KEY inside of it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located beside the door opposite the entrance in the main room.

evidence.quote: Run across to the opposite side of the room and climb up, while standing beside the door look to your right and use the Hookshot to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [048].

subject: Blue Bubble
text: Firing the Hookshot at the blue flame skull extinguishes its fire so it can be damaged by the sword.

evidence.quote: While this enemy is covered in fire he cannot be harmed, target him with the L/Z button and fire your Hookshot to remove the fire and then feel free to dispatch him normally with the sword.

subject: Stalfos
text: Stalfos attacks deal two entire hearts of damage, and waiting to block their attack before executing an A button jump attack works well to defeat them.

evidence.quote: Not only do these (the Stalfos) fight very well, their attacks deal two entire hearts of damage, you have to have a good defense while fighting these enemies as well as a good offense... Wait for the enemy to attack, block it and hit the A button to do a jump attack, this should work quite well and allow you to defeat them with minimal damage.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeating the two Stalfos reveals a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Once the two enemies are dead open the small chest to get a SMALL KEY.

subject: Time Block
text: Playing the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) causes the block obstructing the northwest hallway to disappear.

evidence.quote: Stand in front of this block and play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down.)  The block will disappear and you can go through the door.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Defeating the blue flame skull unlocks the doors and reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: In the next room whip out the Hookshot and fire it at the skull to remove its blue fire, then kill it.  This will unlock the doors and reveal a large chest containing the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Red Switch
text: Stepping on the red button lowers the water level in the courtyard.

evidence.quote: Upon landing step on the red button to lower the water level and then jump off the balcony.

subject: Small Key
text: A small chest at the end of the drained well tunnel contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Jump 
down into it, get the Recovery Hearts and run to the end of the tunnel to find 
a small chest containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Recovery Heart
text: A small chest on the raised land in the water contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest to get a RECOVERY HEART and then take a few steps in front of it to find GOLD SKULLTULA [049] 
crawling around on the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling on the wall just past the Recovery Heart chest in the courtyard.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest to get a RECOVERY HEART and then take a few steps in front of it to find GOLD SKULLTULA [049] 
crawling around on the wall.  Use your Hookshot to get the token and then jump 
down and go through the door which takes you back to the main hall again.

subject: Blue Bubble
text: Blocking a blue flame skull with the shield will knock away its blue flame.

evidence.quote:
In the next 
room you will be attacked immediately by one of the blue flame skulls, since 
you probably don't have time to use your Hookshot note that blocking it with 
your shield will also knock away the blue flame.

subject: Block Puzzle
text: Pull the first block backward, push it forward into the wall, then push it from the obstructed hallway side until it drops into place.

evidence.quote:
Grab it with the A button and pull backward until it is aligned 
with the path in the direction you were moving previously before Navi 
interrupted you.  Now push the block up in that direction until you eventually 
hit the wall.  At that point turn around and go down the hall which the block 
was obstructing previously, make your way around to the same block again but 
from a different side.  Push it along until the end where it drops down a 
little, this means you have done it correctly, listen for the confirmation 
sound.

subject: Block Puzzle
text: Pull the second block out, drop down to push it from the lower hallway, then return upstairs to push it along until it drops into place.

evidence.quote:
At the first fork look left to find another block, just a different colour 
this time... After 
you've got it out as far as you can drop down to the lower area and head to 
the hall which had the original block.  Climb up the ladder here and make a 
right, then a right again.  Push the second block as far as it will go, then 
turn around and go back up again.  Now that the second block is aligned in the 
hall, push it along to the end where it will drop down and you'll hear a 
sound.

subject: Fairy Bow
text: Defeating the reviving Stalfos pair by lowering both with two jump attacks before finishing them reveals a large chest containing the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote:
The trick to winning here is to hit the 
first Stalfos with two jump attacks, then hit the second Stalfos with two jump 
attacks.  Now both of them only have one more jump attack before they die, 
quickly kill one and then move onto the other, with only one hit you can kill 
it before the second has a chance to revive.  Doing this makes a large chest 
appear containing the FAIRY BOW, a very important item you will need.

subject: Small Key
text: Shooting all three paintings with the Fairy Bow causes the Poe to appear, and defeating it lights a torch and spawns a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Do this to all three paintings when they have the Poes in them and 
the Poe will come out.  Go down to the bottom of the stairs and battle it, it 
takes three jump attacks with your Master Sword to kill them.  When the Poe 
dies it lights the torch and a chest appears containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Compass
text: Shooting all three paintings and defeating the second Poe lights a torch and spawns a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Shoot your Fairy Bow at all three paintings 
in this room as well, then kill the Poe when it appears.  Once again a torch 
is lit and a large chest appears.  This large chest contains the COMPASS for 
the dungeon.

subject: Bundle of Arrows
text: Shooting the eyeball on the wall above the ladder by the first large green block spawns a small chest containing a Bundle of Arrows.

evidence.quote:
If you go back to where 
that first large green block was, and climb the ladder you will find an 
eyeball on the wall.  Shoot it to make a small chest appear containing a 
BUNDLE OF ARROWS, that's right, just arrows.

subject: Boss Key
text: Shooting the eyeball above the door untwists the hallway, leading to a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Just outside the twisted 
hallway turn around and look above the door to see an eyeball there.  Shoot it 
with your Fairy Bow to untwist the twisted hallway... Anyway head through the hallway 
which is no longer twisted and jump down.  Here you will find a fancy chest 
which contains the BOSS KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is crawling high on the wall past the raised stone object with two Recovery Hearts.

evidence.quote:
Ahead of you is a raised stone object with two Recovery Hearts on it.  Jump to 
this thing and walk slowly to the end.  Equip your Hookshot and aim it up at 
the wall, there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [050] crawling around on the wall.  If you 
have been following the guide up to this point then congratulations, you now 
officially have exactly half of the game's total Gold Skulltulas.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeating the charging hand enemy and its smaller splits spawns a small chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
After it is defeated it splits into little hands.  
At that point just kill them off with the Hookshot or use the Spin Attack or whatever.  
A small chest appears now containing a SMALL KEY.
